1.Name: Hidden Village
1.Desc: On the 15th of Luxmon, I received a commission. Strange events had been taking place in a village on the border of the empire. The people were plagued with nightmares, and my job was to investigate the village to find out more. Though reports suggested that this wasn't the work of anything sinister, any demon hunter who believes blindly in reports soon pays a terrible price. Usually, investigations like these can be carried out alone. But something didn't feel right. Jobs like this are a dime a dozen for demon hunters, but it's always best to be prepared. A lot of the time, your fate is set in stone before you even start out. I agreed to split the reward with Raine, and we made our way toward a little village in the mountains...

2.Name: Vexing Voodoo
2.Desc: The 23rd day of Duramon. The sweltering sun is putting everyone on edge. I wonder if it's due to the weather, but it's been a while since any demon bounty was offered. This should be good news, but for a monster hunter like me, it also means a dwindling income. Just when the thought arose, a private bounty request landed at my doorstep…

3.Name: Mine Mayhem
3.Desc: On the 13th day of Eomon, the Demon Hunter Brotherhood commissioned a tricky investigation into the Old Mine with the goal of scavenging some of the tech left behind by the dwarves. The Old Mine has long been abandoned, and there's a high chance that any search will come up empty. What's more, Fawkes and Mirael both are off on their own missions, so I'm the only one left for the job. Us bounty hunters live life on the edge of a knife. Good intel and reliable bullets are the difference between life and death, but you have to go out there and risk your life before you can afford these kinds of things. But my luck held up, and I was able to meet a "guide" to the mines, who would prove essential in my eventual survival.
